nodes.name: Contextual Confusion Correction
nodes.modification: replace a global verifier confusion matrix with a predeclared contextual channel

nodes.name: Policy-Divergence Noise Tracker
nodes.modification: add policy-divergence and time features to the contextual channel
nodes.rejection_reason: special case of H-001 plus a schedule

nodes.name: Online Negative Appeal
nodes.modification: appeal verifier negatives to a stronger judge
nodes.rejection_reason: directly covered by NoisyVerifierRL

nodes.name: Doubly Robust Audit Gradient
nodes.modification: augment outcome regression with an inverse-channel residual correction for the clean gradient
nodes.rejection_reason: augmentation cancels to channel-only correction and fails the regression-only-correct cell

nodes.name: Nuisance-Orthogonal Reward
nodes.modification: remove verifier-reward projection onto declared manipulable nuisance directions

nodes.name: Stratified Worst-Case Confusion DRO
nodes.modification: optimize over a confusion-matrix uncertainty set
nodes.rejection_reason: generic pessimistic proxy optimization

nodes.name: Latent Failure-Mode Mixture
nodes.modification: replace observed strata with latent confusion experts
nodes.rejection_reason: overparameterized H-001

nodes.name: Counterfactual Pair Control Variate
nodes.modification: use semantics-preserving paired reward differences as a control variate
nodes.rejection_reason: no material advantage over direct pair averaging in the preregistered construction

nodes.name: Dual-Verifier Disagreement Weighting
nodes.modification: downweight verifier disagreement
nodes.rejection_reason: covered by reward ensembles and hybrid verification

nodes.name: Selective Abstention Gradient
nodes.modification: mask high-risk verifier outcomes
nodes.rejection_reason: filtering does not correct the causal error

nodes.name: Posterior Clean-Reward Gradient
nodes.modification: replace observed reward with posterior clean correctness
nodes.rejection_reason: forward correction reparameterization

nodes.name: Group Advantage Decontamination
nodes.modification: correct rewards before group centering
nodes.rejection_reason: H-001 expressed in GRPO notation

nodes.name: Baseline-Only Noise Control Variate
nodes.modification: adjust only the group baseline for verifier bias
nodes.rejection_reason: cannot remove action-correlated reward bias

nodes.name: Clean-Gradient Leverage Auditing
nodes.modification: acquire audits by expected reduction in clean-gradient covariance

nodes.name: Verifier-Adversarial Curriculum
nodes.modification: adversarially retrain the verifier on policy failures
nodes.rejection_reason: standard adversarial verification engineering

nodes.name: Two-Timescale Channel Game
nodes.modification: increase channel updates per policy update
nodes.rejection_reason: schedule-only change

nodes.name: Audit-Propensity Corrected Channel
nodes.modification: inverse-propensity correct adaptively selected audits
nodes.rejection_reason: auxiliary requirement of H-014 rather than an independent branch

nodes.name: Conformal Lower Clean-Reward Bound
nodes.modification: optimize an audit-calibrated lower bound on clean correctness
nodes.rejection_reason: coverage fails every preregistered downward-shift stress cell

nodes.name: Hierarchical Shrinkage Confusion Strata
nodes.modification: partially pool contextual confusion matrices
nodes.rejection_reason: parameterization of H-001

nodes.name: Change-Point Correction Reset
nodes.modification: reset channel state at residual change points
nodes.rejection_reason: schedule-only change subsumed by H-001 diagnostics

nodes.name: Negative-Control Verifier Bridge
nodes.modification: identify a latent-exploit clean-gradient reward through randomized verifier proxies and sparse audit bridge moments
nodes.rejection_reason: zero strong latent-exploit gain cells; direct proxy regression won 28 of 30 strong comparisons

nodes.name: Policy-Transported Audit Moment
nodes.modification: importance transport old audit moments to the current policy distribution
nodes.rejection_reason: OCRM and standard covariate-shift weighting already cover the mathematical object

nodes.name: Gradient-Flat Verifier Trust Region
nodes.modification: penalize reward-gradient sharpness
nodes.rejection_reason: directly proposed for RLHF and RLVR reward hacking

nodes.name: Self-Internalization Gradient Gate
nodes.modification: gate verifier-positive updates using a policy internalization diagnostic
nodes.rejection_reason: detector plus masking does not identify clean correctness

nodes.name: Hidden Verifier-View Randomization
nodes.modification: sample a hidden verifier view after response generation
nodes.rejection_reason: auxiliary proxy construction or hybrid verification rather than an independent estimand

nodes.name: Quantile-Randomized Reward Update
nodes.modification: randomize updates within a top observed-reward quantile
nodes.rejection_reason: direct specialization of corrupted-reward quantilisation

nodes.name: Audit-Identified Gradient Set Direction
nodes.modification: replace one corrected gradient with the full audit-compatible clean-gradient identified set and select a maximin separating direction
nodes.rejection_reason: zero of 45 asymmetric non-collinear cells reached 0.05 gain; maximum gain 0.011294 and H-001 midpoint won 332/400 comparisons

nodes.name: Distributional Entropic Clean Reward
nodes.modification: use a negative-temperature log moment generating reward
nodes.rejection_reason: distributional KL-DRO effective reward and uncertainty-aware pessimism already cover the object

nodes.name: Anytime-Valid Audit Release
nodes.modification: release updates using an anytime-valid audit confidence sequence
nodes.rejection_reason: adaptive-policy confidence sequences already exist and release gating is auxiliary

nodes.name: Cross-Judge Consensus Gradient
nodes.modification: aggregate multiple verifier gradient directions by a robust center
nodes.rejection_reason: reward ensembles already cover aggregation and shared judge errors survive consensus

nodes.name: Commit-First De-Anchored Reward
nodes.modification: make the judge solve and commit before candidate exposure
nodes.rejection_reason: directly proposed as the effective training reward intervention

nodes.name: Hacking-Onset Sentinel Reset
nodes.modification: roll back training after an onset detector alert
nodes.rejection_reason: existing onset detection plus a schedule reset does not identify clean gradient

nodes.name: Privacy-Stable Reusable Audit Gradient
nodes.modification: replace exact repeated clean-audit gradient queries with clipped privacy-accounted vector releases and a composed privacy filter
nodes.rejection_reason: 118/144 cells exceeded the bias threshold, 127/144 missed cosine, 82/144 exceeded false-positive rate, and zero cells achieved incremental gain over exact baselines

nodes.name: Modewise Youden Barrier
nodes.modification: gate mode updates at the Youden-index phase boundary
nodes.rejection_reason: published phase boundary plus H-001 channel correction and a gate

nodes.name: Counterfactual-Invariant Reward Head
nodes.modification: factor causal and noncausal reward representations with counterfactual invariance
nodes.rejection_reason: two direct causal reward-modeling methods already instantiate the object

nodes.name: Trusted Update Subspace
nodes.modification: project policy gradients into a clean reference update subspace
nodes.rejection_reason: Directional Alignment directly proposes trusted-direction projection

nodes.name: Adversarial Hacker-Auditor Gate
nodes.modification: learn a hacker and latent auditor then gate reward
nodes.rejection_reason: ARA directly implements the same two-stage game and gate

nodes.name: Real-Time Policy-Feedback Reward Adapter
nodes.modification: adapt reward prediction using current policy hidden states
nodes.rejection_reason: R2M directly proposes policy-feedback reward adaptation
